prompt: Our iOS 26 UIKit unit test assigns a filled UIButton.Configuration with a title and subtitle, disables the button, and passes it into a summary view. It then compares button.configuration with the original configuration value. The equality check fails, but the summary code never sets the button configuration. How would you determine whether this is a product bug or a test problem, and what should a preservation test assert? Please distinguish what you can establish from the code from what needs an actual test result.
